headword: {永久磁石|えいきゅうじしゃく}

definitions.explanation: A magnet that retains its magnetism without an external electric current. Made from materials such as ferrite or neodymium, used in motors, speakers, sensors, and many everyday devices.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{永久磁石|えいきゅうじしゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}われている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Permanent magnets are used in refrigerator doors.

examples.japanese: ネオジム{永久磁石|えいきゅうじしゃく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{強力|きょうりょく}→強力：02656_kyouryoku⟧だ。
examples.english: Neodymium permanent magnets are extremely powerful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦モーター→モーター：23127_mootaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{永久磁石|えいきゅうじしゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{組|く}み{込|こ}まれて→組み込む：06983_kumikomu⟧おり、⟦{効率|こうりつ}→効率：11794_kouritsu⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{回転|かいてん}→回転：00141_kaiten⟧⟦エネルギー→エネルギー：03834_enerugii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|う}み{出|だ}す→生み出す：10423_umidasu⟧。
examples.english: Permanent magnets are built into electric motors to efficiently generate rotational energy.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{永久|えいきゅう}→永久：01875_eikyuu⟧ (permanent, eternal) and ⟦{磁石|じしゃく}→磁石：04211_jishaku⟧ (magnet). Contrasts with ⟦{電磁石|でんじしゃく}→電磁石：23838_denjishaku⟧ (electromagnet), which requires electric current to generate a magnetic field.

Japan is a major producer of high-performance permanent magnets, particularly neodymium magnets, which are essential components in electric vehicles, wind turbines, and electronics.
